hook_enumeration: 25 blocks in downloaded configs; actual model enumeration mandatory
pooling: mean over nucleotide positions; right pad 1000, pad1; validate tokenizer before use

probe.cv: identical StratifiedGroupKFold splits across arms for each seed
probe.threshold: binary .5; multiclass sorted numeric class argmax

bootstrap.group: qualified biological groups if available; otherwise exact/RC groups with explicit limits
bootstrap.multiplicity: pointwise exploratory unadjusted; all layers/seeds visible

causal_loss: single LM-output statistic; summed next-token loss / valid targets; distinct from classifier CE
heldout_access: No untouched test member access; restored previously analyzed H3 outputs remain exploratory
filler_policy: pad1 filler rows; exclude all filler outputs

metric_definitions.auroc: binary class1; splice macro one-vs-rest in sorted numeric class order
metric_definitions.average_precision: binary class1; splice mean of per-class one-vs-rest AP
metric_definitions.classification_cross_entropy: sklearn log_loss float64 probabilities; distinct from LM NLL

bootstrap_invalid: reject missing-class draws consistently; record valid/invalid counts
study: Pod B supplied relearning descriptive evaluation

checkpoint_coverage.true_step_zero: not present in supplied trajectory listings

primary_anchors.interpretation: exploratory historical anchor; zero-based block16 is seventeenth block

comparison_families.qualified_parent_relative: only if exact initialization parent is established
comparison_families.true_trajectory_start_relative: unavailable until true start qualifies; step100 is not silently relabeled step0
comparison_families.matched_step_between_series: iteration-counter descriptive contrast only; exposure and initialization confounding retained
comparison_families.within_series_step100_reference: optional explicitly first-delivered-relative exploratory contrasts; not true-start-relative

coverage_selection.subset_rule: If measured new-checkpoint extraction, full fitting/bootstrap/audit and backup forecast cannot fit remaining pre-cutoff window, use the same predefined steps for both series plus any qualified true initial references; never select by scores
coverage_selection.activation_status: not activated while all checkpoints blocked

fitting: separately refitted heads plus compatible fixed-base and qualified own-initial reference heads; reuse exact-compatible prior heads/controls
